title: Reading the ledger back
intro: The ledger is append-only and is the canonical record of what happened. The event vocabulary is closed, so a filter can tell an unknown name from one that has not occurred.

scenarios.title: What this task has done so far
scenarios.explain: Oldest first, each line carrying the timestamp, the event, the task and the git head it happened at.

scenarios.title: Filtering on a name that is not registered
scenarios.explain: Answering "no matching events" would be the same answer a registered name that has not occurred gives. A filter that cannot distinguish those two is not a filter, so this is refused and the vocabulary is printed.
